about.seoTitle: About Branding Supply — brand strategy in a conversation with George
about.seoDescription: Branding Supply builds brand foundations in a conversation: purpose, values, archetype, voice — reasoned, written down, ready to ship. Who we are, what we believe, how we work.
about.title: We are our own proof.
about.intro1: We exist because good branding is too often either too expensive or reduced to a template. We believe every brand is a fingerprint — and the way there can be guided, reasoned and measured.
about.intro2: So we applied our products to ourselves first: the name, the fingerprint, this color world, this page — all of it came out of the Brand Wizard, our Visual DNA and our own playbook. Scored by Ada, naturally.
about.fingerprint: Branding Supply · The Sage · rest Creator — style: minimal · editorial — visual DNA: contemporary · geometric · monochrome + acid pop · spacious · digital-clean · precise
about.heroImage: A sheet of heavy paper carrying the Branding Supply brand fingerprint, a single acid-green dot beside it
about.whyTitle: Good branding used to be a choice between expensive and generic.
about.whyAgencyBody: Asks the right questions, thinks strategically, gives reasons — and costs five figures, takes months and stays out of reach for most founders.
about.whyGeneratorBody: Delivers in seconds — a template. No follow-up question, no reasoning, none of the one sentence only you can say.
about.whyUsBody: Asks like an agency, answers like an advisor, works at the pace of a conversation. Every decision reasoned, every decision written down — and the brand stays yours.
about.whyImage: Three objects side by side: a heavy agency folder, a plastic stencil and a small speaker with an acid-green accent
about.principlesTitle: Three principles everything is measured against.
about.p1Body: Every recommendation carries its why. A decision you cannot retrace is not one — so George explains instead of announcing, and every reason is written down.
about.p2Body: George asks, proposes, sometimes pushes back — but nothing is confirmed without you. A chapter only closes when you say it fits. The brand stays yours.
about.p3Body: What you share in the conversation becomes brand foundation — not training material. Brand content only ever goes to AI providers that do not retain it; where that is not guaranteed, the job does not run.
about.howTitle: From the first sentence to a foundation that holds.
about.howLead: Your brand foundation stands after roughly 45 minutes of conversation — pause any time, your progress is saved.
about.h1Body: George asks the questions a good agency would ask — one at a time, digging deeper where an answer is thin. “I don’t know” is a legitimate answer.
about.h1Image: Two chairs facing each other across a small table, seen from above, monochrome with a single acid-green dot
about.h2Body: Your answers become drafts: purpose, values, archetype, voice. You confirm or revise — nothing is adopted silently, and contradictions get named instead of smoothed over.
about.h2Image: A stack of index cards, one card lifted and lit, with an acid-green edge
about.h3Body: What is decided lives in your brand document: readable, reasoned, in your language. The foundation that design, copy and everything after builds on.
about.h3Image: A closed, bound document with a thin acid-green ribbon bookmark
about.proofTitle: This page came out of the Wizard.
about.proofBody: Name, fingerprint, color world, voice — everything here was made with the same tools you use. No agency, no template: one conversation, one document, one brand. Scored by Ada, naturally.
about.proofImage: The Branding Supply brand fingerprint as a geometric, monochrome poster on a wall
about.faqTitle: What you want to know before you start.
about.faq1A: Founders, small teams and companies ahead of a relaunch — anyone who needs a solid brand foundation before design and communication begin.
about.faq2A: The foundation — context, purpose, values, archetype and voice — stands after roughly 45 minutes of conversation. Pause any time; your progress is saved.
about.faq3A: No — it replaces the expensive part before one. Design, campaigns and execution build on the foundation; agencies and designers work faster with it and without guesswork.
about.faq4A: It becomes brand foundation, not training material. Brand content only ever goes to AI providers that do not retain it — where that is not guaranteed, the job does not run.
about.faq5A: Nothing during the closed beta. The foundation stays free afterwards, too — you only pay for what is derived from it: design, brand book, kit.
about.faq6A: Because a name carries responsibility. George is the one advisor who holds the thread — from the first question to the document. Behind him works a team with clear responsibilities.
about.teamTeaserBody: George leads the conversation — behind him, every task is taken by the specialist who does it best.

team.teamTitle: The right team member for every task.
team.teamIntro: We break your project into tasks — and each one is taken by the specialist who does it best. Seven roles, clear boundaries, one shared memory.
team.crewTitle: George speaks — the team stands behind him.
team.crewIntro: You have ONE conversation, from the first question to the finished document: George stays your counterpart in every chapter. What changes is the way he asks — he borrows the view of the specialists he went through the chapter with, and he tells you whose view it is.
team.ctaText: The team is ready — George asks the first question.
team.seoTitle: The Branding Supply team — George and seven specialists
team.seoDescription: George leads the conversation, a team of specialists takes each task: strategy, design, brand book, content, monitoring, score, benchmark. Who does what for your brand.
team.georgeBody: He asks the questions a good agency would ask, backs every recommendation and writes every decision down. Design belongs to Frida; when it comes to names, Otto takes over — the thread he never lets go of.
team.georgeImage: Portrait of a calm brand advisor against a neutral grey backdrop, monochrome with one acid-green detail on the lapel
team.teamImage: The seven-person team in a bright studio, monochrome, one acid-green accent
team.flowLead: Nobody on the team works in the dark: every role builds on what was decided before it.
team.flow1Body: George leads the conversation; Vera, Milo, Nika and Otto take their chapters. At the end stands the brand document.
team.flow2Body: Frida translates the foundation into visual DNA and three directions — strategy becomes visible before a logo exists.
team.flow3Body: Rex gets what was decided ready to ship: brand book, tokens, brand.json, press kit — nothing new, all of it usable.
team.flow4Body: Kira takes the brand into the world, Wanda watches its outside image, Ada computes the score, Scout keeps an eye on the market.
team.flowImage: Four objects in a row: notebook, colour swatch fan, bound book, antenna — joined by an acid-green thread

lead.title: Secure your spot in the beta.
lead.body: We open access in waves. Sign up — we will get in touch as soon as your spot is ready. Already have a code? Redeem it right away.
